name: Hashcat
summary: The world's fastest and most advanced password recovery utility. Utilizes GPU acceleration for massively parallel hash cracking.
highlights: --hex-charset — Assume charset is given in hex
--hex-salt — Assume salt is given in hex
--hex-wordlist — Assume words in wordlist are given in hex
--status — Enable automatic update of the status screen

examples.explanation: Perform a brute-force attack (mode 3) with the default hashcat mask
Perform a brute-force attack (mode 3) with a known pattern of 4 digits
Perform a brute-force attack (mode 3) using at most 8 of all printable ASCII characters
Perform a dictionary attack (mode 0) using a wordlist
Run a dictionary attack (mode 0) using the specified wordlist, applying rule-based transformations to mutate candidate passwords
Perform a combination attack (mode 1) using the concatenation of words from two different custom dictionaries
Show result of an already cracked hash
